## Description

Clinic settings: connected channels and their state, assistant name, languages, working hours for handover, allowed tools, opt-in text. Platform console: per-tenant webhook last seen, delivery failure rate, token expiry, template status, provisioning and a kill switch, from counts and states only. Plans gate which channels a tenant may use.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The kill switch stops all AI replies and outbound sends for that tenant within one minute, audited.
- [ ] **AC2.** The console shows no message text or patient data (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Settings changes are audited; only admins can change them (server-side policy).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
